# HEU saliva 
```{r}
# =====================================================
# 1. SUBSET HEU
# =====================================================

physeq_HEU <- subset_samples(
  physeq_all_389,
  study_group == "HEU"
)

physeq_HEU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HEU) > 0,
  physeq_HEU
)

# =====================================================
# PREVALENCE FILTER
# taxa present in >=10% samples
# =====================================================

prev_threshold <- 0.1 * nsamples(physeq_HEU)

physeq_HEU <- filter_taxa(
  physeq_HEU,
  function(x) sum(x > 0) >= prev_threshold,
  prune = TRUE
)

physeq_HEU <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_HEU) > 5,
  physeq_HEU
)

physeq_HEU

# =====================================================
# 2. EXTRACT METADATA
# =====================================================

meta_HEU <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HEU))

meta_HEU <- meta_HEU %>%
  mutate(
    host_age = as.numeric(host_age),
    host_sex = as.factor(host_sex),
    caries_IL = as.factor(caries_IL),
    logCD4 = log10(CD4.Count.1)
  )

meta_HEU$logCD4_c <- scale(
  meta_HEU$logCD4,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
)

# =====================================================
# 3. MATCH CYTOKINE MATRIX
# =====================================================

cytok_LLOD30 <- masaliva_LODimputed389_filt   

colnames(cytok_LLOD30)

cyto_HEU <- cytok_LLOD30[
  rownames(meta_HEU),
]

# =====================================================
# 4. LOG TRANSFORM
# =====================================================

cyto_HEU_log <- log10(cyto_HEU + 1e-5)

# =====================================================
# 5. RESIDUALIZE CYTOKINES
# regress out age + sex
# =====================================================

cyto_resid_HEU <- apply(
  cyto_HEU_log,
  2,
  function(y) {
    fit <- lm(
      y ~ host_age + host_sex,
      data = meta_HEU
    )
    residuals(fit)
  }
)

cyto_resid_HEU <- as.data.frame(cyto_resid_HEU)
rownames(cyto_resid_HEU) <- rownames(meta_HEU)

```




# mclust HEU Saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Choose cytokine matrix
# =========================================================

cytok_mat <- cyto_resid_HEU

# Keep shared samples only
shared_ids <- intersect(
  rownames(cytok_mat),
  rownames(meta_HEU)
)

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[shared_ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta_sub_HEU <- meta_HEU[shared_ids, ]

# -----------------------------
# Remove non-numeric columns
# -----------------------------
cytok_mat <- cytok_mat %>%
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

# -----------------------------
# Remove near-zero variance variables
# -----------------------------
vars <- apply(
  cytok_mat,
  2,
  var,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cytok_mat <- cytok_mat[
  ,
  vars > 0,
  drop = FALSE
]

# -----------------------------
# Scale data
# -----------------------------
X <- scale(cytok_mat)

# =========================================================
# PCA
# =========================================================

pca_res <- prcomp(
  X,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# Scree plot
fviz_eig(
  pca_res,
  addlabels = TRUE,
  ylim = c(0, 60)
) +
  ggtitle("HEU Cytokines: Scree Plot")

# Variance explained
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 /
  sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

variance_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(var_explained)),
  Variance = var_explained,
  Cumulative = cumsum(var_explained)
)

print(variance_df)

# =========================================================
# Choose PCs for clustering
# =========================================================

n_pcs <- which(
  cumsum(var_explained) >= 0.80
)[1]

cat("Using", n_pcs, "PCs for Mclust\n")

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:n_pcs]
)

# =========================================================
# Mclust
# =========================================================

mc <- Mclust(pca_scores)

summary(mc)

# Cluster assignments
clusters <- factor(mc$classification)

# Add to metadata
meta_sub_HEU$Mclust_cluster <- clusters

table(meta_sub_HEU$Mclust_cluster)

```

#Biplot HEU
```{r}
#----------------------------------------------------------
# BIPLOT — HEU Saliva
#----------------------------------------------------------

# =========================================================
# PCA dataframe
# =========================================================

pca_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca_res$x),
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  meta_sub_HEU
)

# -----------------------------
# PCA scores (samples)
# -----------------------------
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
scores$Cluster <- pca_df$Mclust_cluster

# -----------------------------
# PCA loadings (variables)
# -----------------------------
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_res$rotation)

# Scale arrows for visualization
arrow_scale <- 3

loadings$Cytokine <- rownames(loadings)

# -----------------------------
# Variance explained
# -----------------------------
var_explained <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)
pc1_var <- round(100 * var_explained[1], 1)
pc2_var <- round(100 * var_explained[2], 1)


# -----------------------------
# Cluster colors — HEU
# -----------------------------
cluster_colors <- c(
  "1" = "#D73027",
  "2" = "#2C7BB6"
  # "3" = "#1B9E77"
)


# =========================================================
# PCA BIPLOT
# =========================================================

p_HEU_saliva_biplot <- ggplot() +

  # Samples
  geom_point(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  # Cluster ellipses
  stat_ellipse(
    data = scores,
    aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # Cytokine loading arrows
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      yend = PC2 * arrow_scale
    ),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +

  # Cytokine labels
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * arrow_scale,
      y = PC2 * arrow_scale,
      label = Cytokine
    ),
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +

  # Cluster colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cluster_colors,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "S1",
      "2" = "S2"
    ),
    name = "HEU Phenotype"
  )  +

  # Labels
  labs(
    # title = "PCA Biplot of saliva Cytokines in HEU",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )


# Display plot
p_HEU_saliva_biplot

```

#Box plot HEU
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare dataframe
# =========================================================

plot_df <- cytok_mat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = clusters,
    Sample = rownames(cytok_mat)
  )


# =========================================================
# Convert to long format
# =========================================================

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cluster, Sample),
    names_to = "Cytokine",
    values_to = "Value"
  )


# =========================================================
# Create saliva phenotype labels
# 1 = S1, 2 = S2
# =========================================================

plot_long$Phenotype <- factor(
  plot_long$Cluster,
  levels = c("1", "2"),
  labels = c("S1", "S2")
)

table(plot_long$Phenotype)


# =========================================================
# Order cytokines
# =========================================================

plot_long_order <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    Cytokine = factor(
      Cytokine,
      levels = c(
        #"Saliva_IL1_alpha", # not significant; excluded for even figure panel
        "Saliva_IL8",
        "Saliva_MCP1",
        "Saliva_IFN_gamma",
        "Saliva_IL4",
        "Saliva_IL5",
        "Saliva_IL6"
      )
    )
  )


# =========================================================
# Wilcoxon tests
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Phenotype
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "Phenotype")


# =========================================================
# Colors
# =========================================================

phenotype_colors <- c(
  "S1" = "#D73027",
  "S2" = "#2C7BB6"
)


# =========================================================
# Plot each cytokine
# =========================================================

cytokine_order <- levels(plot_long_order$Cytokine)

p_list <- lapply(cytokine_order, function(cyt) {

  subdf <- plot_long_order %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  pair_sub <- pairwise_df %>%
    filter(Cytokine == cyt)

  ggplot(
    subdf,
    aes(
      x = Phenotype,
      y = Value,
      fill = Phenotype
    )
  ) +

    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.35,
      alpha = 0.85,
      outlier.shape = NA
    ) +

    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Phenotype),
      width = 0.12,
      size = 1.5,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    stat_pvalue_manual(
      pair_sub,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 4
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = phenotype_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = phenotype_colors) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +

    labs(
      title = gsub("Saliva_", "", cyt),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 12,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
})


# =========================================================
# Combine
# =========================================================

final_plot_saliva_HEU <- wrap_plots(
  p_list,
  ncol = 3
) +
  plot_annotation(
    # title = "Saliva Cytokine Levels Across Phenotypes in HEU"
  )


final_plot_saliva_HEU

# =========================================================
# Add global axis labels
# =========================================================

box_HEU_saliva_2 <- ggdraw(final_plot_saliva_HEU) +
  draw_label(
    "HEU Phenotype",
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.005,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  draw_label(
    "Log10 cytokine level (age- and sex-adjusted)",
    x = 0.0,
    y = 0.5,
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 1
  )

box_HEU_saliva_2


```

# Significant and effect sizes HEU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon tests (BH-adjusted)
# =========================================================

pairwise_df <- plot_long_order %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(
    Value ~ Cluster,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# =========================================================
# Rank-biserial effect sizes for each pairwise comparison
# =========================================================

eff12 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "2")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "2"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff13 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "1",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

eff23 <- plot_long_order %>%
  filter(Cluster %in% c("2", "3")) %>%
  group_by(Cytokine) %>%
  wilcox_effsize(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = "2",
    group2 = "3"
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

effect_df <- bind_rows(
  eff12,
  eff13,
  eff23
) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  )

# =========================================================
# Merge Wilcoxon results with effect sizes
# =========================================================

wilcox_effect_table <- pairwise_df %>%
  left_join(
    effect_df,
    by = c("Cytokine", "group1", "group2")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 1),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p.adj = signif(p.adj, 3),
    effsize = round(effsize, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2,
    n1,
    n2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p.adj,
    p.adj.signif,
    effsize,
    magnitude
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Cytokine,
    group1,
    group2
  )

# =========================================================
# Display
# =========================================================

print(wilcox_effect_table)

# Optional data frame for export
wilcox_effect_table_df <- as.data.frame(wilcox_effect_table)

wilcox_effect_table_df

```

#Beta diversity  HUU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Create phyloseq object with HUU cluster assignments
# =========================================================

if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU)) {
  physeq_HUU <- t(physeq_HUU)
}

physeq_HUU

physeq_HUU_clust <- physeq_HUU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HUU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HUU$host_sex)
rownames(meta_sub_HUU) <- meta_sub_HUU$host_subject_id

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HUU)

physeq_HUU_clust

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Extract OTU table (counts)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- as(otu_table(physeq_HUU_clust), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_HUU_clust)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

otu <- as.data.frame(otu)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(physeq_HUU_clust))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Bray-Curtis distance
# ---------------------------------------------------------
otu <- otu / rowSums(otu)

bray <- vegdist(
  otu,
  method = "bray"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCoA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pcoa <- cmdscale(
  bray,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

var_exp <- pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0])

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcoa$points[, 1],
  PC2 = pcoa$points[, 2],
  meta
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Overall PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

perm_cluster <- adonis2(
  bray ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta,
  by = "margin"
)

perm_cluster

# =========================================================
# Pairwise PERMANOVA
# =========================================================

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 2
# -------------------------
phy_12 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "2")
)

phy_12 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_12) > 0,
  phy_12
)

bray_12 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_12,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_12 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_12))

set.seed(123)

adonis_12 <- adonis2(
  bray_12 ~ Mclust_cluster +
    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_12,
  by = "margin"
)

# -------------------------
# 1 vs 3
# -------------------------
phy_13 <- subset_samples(
  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("1", "3")
)

phy_13 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_13) > 0,
  phy_13
)

bray_13 <- phyloseq::distance(
  phy_13,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_13 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_13))

set.seed(123)

adonis_13 <- adonis2(

    caries_IL +
    host_age +
    host_sex +
    logCD4_c,
  data = meta_13,

)

# -------------------------
# 2 vs 3
# -------------------------

  physeq_HUU_clust,
  Mclust_cluster %in% c("2", "3")
)

phy_23 <- prune_taxa(

)

set.seed(123)
```

#ANCOMBC HEU saliva

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Prepare phyloseq object for ANCOM-BC2 (HEU)
# =========================================================

# Make sure taxa are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(physeq_HEU)) {
  physeq_HEU <- t(physeq_HEU)
}

physeq_HEU_ancom <- physeq_HEU

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Metadata formatting
# ---------------------------------------------------------
meta_sub_HEU$Mclust_cluster <- factor(meta_sub_HEU$Mclust_cluster)
meta_sub_HEU$caries_IL <- factor(meta_sub_HEU$caries_IL)
meta_sub_HEU$host_sex <- factor(meta_sub_HEU$host_sex)

table(meta_sub_HEU$Mclust_cluster)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure sample order matches
# ---------------------------------------------------------
sample_data(physeq_HEU_ancom) <- sample_data(meta_sub_HEU)

physeq_HEU_ancom

# =========================================================
# Run ANCOM-BC2
# =========================================================

library(ANCOMBC)
set.seed(123)

ancom_res_HEU <- ancombc2(
  data = physeq_HEU_ancom,

  # Fixed effects
  fix_formula = "Mclust_cluster + caries_IL + host_age + host_sex + logCD4_c",

  # No random effects
  rand_formula = NULL,

  tax_level = "Species",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  s0_perc = 0.05,

  group = "Mclust_cluster",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,

  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100,
    verbose = TRUE
  ),

  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100
  ),

  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),

  mdfdr_control = list(
    fwer_ctrl_method = "BH",
    B = 1
  ),

  global = TRUE,
  pairwise = TRUE,
  # dunnet = TRUE,
  trend = FALSE,

  verbose = TRUE,
  n_cl = 2
)
```



```{r}

# =========================================================
# Extract significant taxa (HEU)
# =========================================================

mclust2_HEU_volc <- ancom_res_HEU$res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    taxon,
    lfc_Mclust_cluster2,
    q_Mclust_cluster2,
    passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2
  ) %>%
  filter(
    passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2 == TRUE
  )



caries <- ancom_res_HEU$res %>%
  dplyr::select(
    taxon,
    lfc_caries_IL1,
    q_caries_IL1,
    passed_ss_caries_IL1
  ) %>%
  filter(
    q_caries_IL1 < 0.1,
    passed_ss_caries_IL1 == TRUE
  ) %>%
  arrange(lfc_caries_IL1)

caries



# =========================================================
# Volcano plot
# =========================================================

# Prepare volcano plot data

df_volcano_HEU <- mclust2_HEU_volc %>%
  mutate(
    color_group = case_when(
      lfc_Mclust_cluster2 < 0 ~ "S1",
      TRUE ~ "S2"
    ),

    # Clean taxon names
    feature = taxon %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_replace_all("\\bsp\\.\\b", "sp.") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+(ATCC|DSM|str\\.|F|CS)\\s*\\d+") %>%
      str_remove("\\s+unknown$") %>%
      str_replace("^([A-Z][a-z]+) unknown$", "\\1 sp.") %>%
      str_replace("sp\\. oral taxon (\\d+).*", "sp. oral taxon \\1") %>%
      str_squish(),

    # Italic labels
    feature_label = paste0("italic('", feature, "')")
  )


```


#Volcano plot HEU
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Volcano plot
# =========================================================

cf_volcano_HEU_saliva <- ggplot(
  df_volcano_HEU,
  aes(
    x = lfc_Mclust_cluster2,
    y = -log10(q_Mclust_cluster2),
    color = color_group
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.8,
    size = 4
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_volcano_HEU %>%
      filter(
        q_Mclust_cluster2 < 0.1,
        passed_ss_Mclust_cluster2
      ),
    aes(label = feature_label),
    parse = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    size = 4,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "S1" = "#D73027",
      "S2" = "#2C7BB6"
    )
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Effect Size (Coefficient)",
    y = expression(-log[10](q-value)),
    color = "HEU Phenotype",
    #title = "Differentially abundant taxa associated with saliva cytokine clusters in HEU"
  ) +

  theme_classic() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


# Display plot
cf_volcano_HEU_saliva
```
